task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.population_law: Independent virtual people with bounded continuous Hb and ferritin marginals joined by a Gaussian copula.

transport.threshold_cell_probabilities: Transport the four source cell proportions unchanged.
transport.ferritin_geometric_mean: Transport the source geometric mean unchanged.
transport.target_weighting: Equal-weight draws represent the specified phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain only under these transport assumptions.

hb.location: Solve the truncated-normal probability below 12 to equal (173+85)/1671.

ferritin.family: Two-piece truncated normal on natural-log ferritin, with separate conditional scales below and above log(15).
ferritin.upper_log_sd: Solve the mixture expectation of log(ferritin) to equal log(17.4).

dependence.interpretation: Latent Gaussian correlation calibrated to the unadjusted source threshold table; not an observed Pearson, residual, multilevel, or Spearman coefficient.

numerics.inverse_cdf_endpoint_guard: Nearest representable floating-point values strictly inside (0,1).
